author: IGN
description:
Check out the Kanji Sizzle Trailer for Persona 4 Revival, a remake of the hit turn-based RPG developed by Atlus. Make way for the legendary delinquent - Kanji Tatsumi in Persona 4 Revival, launching on February 18, 2027, for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Xbox Game Pass, and PC (Steam).

title: Persona 4 Revival - Official Kanji Sizzle Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Check out the Light Bowgun Boosted Action in this latest Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance trailer for the upcoming action RPG expansion. The new trailer spotlights the Light Bowgun and breaks down its Boosted Action, featuring run & gun, gunslinging counters, and a storm of bullets! Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance takes the hunt to new heights in Master Rank. New monsters and challenges, evolved hunting actions and mechanics, a new locale, and the next chapter in the Expedition Team's story await in Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance, available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC in 2027.

#ign #gaming
title: Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance - Official Light Bowgun Boosted Action Trailer

author: IGN
description:
WWE superstars Dominik Mysterio and Penta share their GOAT picks with IGN, answering stupid questions like their GOAT pizza topping and emoji, and also giving us thoughtful answers to things like their GOAT piece of advice and GOAT small joy that always makes life better. 
We also dig into their WWE picks for things like their favourite luchador and what they think is the best WWE match to show a newcomer.

AAA Mega champion and son of WWE legend, Rey Mysterio, Dominik Mysterio defends his title at Triplemania, but perhaps his real challenge is answering what the greatest smell of all time is.

description: Don't miss the Announcement Trailer for Tulpa the Unseen Lover, a romantic visual novel developed by Horse Position.
